changelog:
✨ New Features
• Feed card layout: Add "Default" to "Feed card layout", which keeps the layout that the server sends
• Navigation bar: Add "Enable glass navigation bar" setting
• Navigation bar: Add "Navigation buttons order" and "Toolbar buttons order" settings
• Navigation bar: Added a Glass navigation bar lit rim

🌟 Mod Features
• All Morphe patches for YouTube
• Google and Yandex voice-over translation (VoT)
• Video, audio, thumbnail and subtitle downloader with Save to device
• Customizable preset settings for a Premium-like experience
• Extra clone variant with Dynamic Island on supported devices
• In-app update check for new builds

🐛 Bug Fixes
• Save to Watch later: Implement the refinements for Watch Later screen
• Feed card layout: Comment button of the cards opens the video instead of only the comments panel
• Feed card layout: Feed videos disappear and come back on scroll when the app drops the cached template version
• Feed card layout: Feed videos have no save items in the menu when the cards with a save button are converted to the classic layout
• Feed card layout: Playlists converted to cards have no background below the thumbnail
• Hide layout components: "Hide Explore button" not working in incognito mode
• Hide layout components: Prevent shelves from hiding on Charts, Memberships, and Playables pages
• Navigation bar: Glass navigation bar is wider than its buttons, so the first and the last button are not aligned with the ends of the bar
• Niconico comments: Keep a high refresh rate while comments move
• Niconico comments: Move comments smoothly before the first video state is reported
• Restore original titles: Update titles during background playback
